method: Manual review on owner request. Official legal texts and authority pages retrieved directly; each retrieved document is identified by SHA-256 (for HTML pages the hash identifies the retrieved copy, not a stable page). No secondary source was used to create or remove a ban. Bot checks were not bypassed. Spanish rules are published only for the reviewed November window; December 2026 was not reviewed for ES.
